hints.title: Use preorder plus markers
hints.body: A preorder list of values is not enough to recover the shape. Missing children need explicit markers so the decoder knows when a subtree ends.

hints.title: Write every child slot
hints.body: Every present node writes its value, then recursively writes its left subtree and its right subtree. A null child writes a single marker.

hints.title: Join without a trailing comma
hints.body: Collect tokens in a list and join them with commas. An empty tree produces exactly one marker.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
tokens = empty list
function visit(node):
    if node is null:
        append "#" to tokens
        return
    append node.value to tokens
    visit(node.left)
    visit(node.right)
visit(root)
return join(tokens, ",")
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
